The plate holds a salmon fillet, probably about 120 g, and sliced zucchini and yellow squash, probably about 150 g. Salmon runs roughly 200 kcal per 100 g, so 120 g is about 240 kcal. The squash and zucchini add about 25 kcal for the vegetables themselves, and I'm adding roughly 40 kcal for cooking oil. That makes about 300 kcal across about 270 g of food.
